piece: W1-04 round 4 - settlements, interiors and the people in them
next_step: Live sections L2/L6/L4/L5/L1 running; then L3 (115-room live sweep) in its own invocation; then screenshots; then write the verdict.
overlap_notes: I grade W1-04-r4. Overlap on docs/shots/ and reports/blog-feed.jsonl is by design; the feed is append-only and I append one line. I write no game/ source.

findings.AGGREGATION_FAILS: tools/world/w1-04-consumption.mjs, run end to end (RULES.md rule 9), exits 1: 19/20 CONSUMED. The one DEAD row is 10a, which the builder edited: exterior_restored_on_exit reads 105 in the live arm against a pass condition of 115. The builder shipped without running it.
findings.LAMPS_OUTSIDE: 55 authored lamps in 19 of the 41 shrunk rooms now stand outside their own room's bounds (12 are non-snuffable hearths; worst 2.33 m outside). 0 in rooms the join did not shrink, so the join caused all of them. applyInteriorBounds() clamps continuity.interior_spawn and does not touch lights[]; buildInterior() and sim/stealth/system.js#syncInteriorLights() both place them at the record's verbatim pos.
findings.MESHES_OUTSIDE: 292 built meshes in 63 rooms stand more than 0.6 m outside their own room's bounds — 179 light fittings and 113 props. 218 of them, across 26 rooms, are in the 41 rooms the join shrank.
findings.DOORSTEP_INSIDE_THE_BUILDING: buildings[].door sits at the building CENTRE on 112 of 112 (max door-to-centre distance 0.00 m), and all 112 declared continuity.exterior_spawn points fall inside their own building's wall box. Round 4 is the round that put a covering roof on that box. Being verified live via buildingAt().
findings.PROPS_ITEMS_NPCS: Of the dispatch's three specifics: unique items follow the shrink (0 of 115 outside); NPC interior anchors follow it (anchorFor reads bounds_m, the 1.2 m inset never collapses, smallest joined room 4.34 x 10.94 m); props do NOT entirely (113 prop meshes outside by >0.6 m).
findings.CONFIRMED_JOIN: 41 -> 0 reproduces independently; worst area ratio 1.0887 by bounds; 41 rooms limited, worst archon-market keeping 0.1714.
findings.CONFIRMED_ROOFS: 0 of 202 by my own 8x8 downward raycast above half wall height; the instrument goes red (201 of 202) when every mesh above half height is scaled 0.7 in plan.
findings.CONFIRMED_TAUTOLOGY: bounds_m equals continuity.exterior_footprint_m on 115 of 115 records, so any N1 ratio dividing one by the other is 1.000 by construction. True — but first stated by the round-3 critic, not by this round.
findings.CONFIRMED_NULLING_GONE: api.js __w1_04_perturbSettlement no longer nulls _townCell; it clears _townSolids and calls _settleSettlementSolids(), which owns the handle.
findings.DEEP_OVERLAPS_BOUNDARY: The shipped tool reports 12; the identical formula without its +1e-6 epsilon reports 14 (lilmoth 3 not 2, stormhold 1 not 0). Two pairs sit exactly on the 45% line.
findings.MY_OWN_PROBE_DEFECT: My first offline census called buildInterior(rec) instead of buildInterior(root, rec) and traversed 0 meshes in 115 of 115 rooms while reporting a clean '0 props outside'. Caught by rule 4, fixed, and an explicit vacuity assertion added.

method_deviations: node tools/contention.mjs --gate returned GO at every check I made.

I killed my own stalled live run with `pkill -f headless_shell`, which is not scoped to my process and may have killed a neighbour's browser. That was careless and is reported rather than hidden (rule 26). Browsers were running again within 30 s. Every later kill is by my own PID.

My first live instrument ran all 115 doors inside one page.evaluate with no intermediate write and outlived its wrapper — the same wall the builder reported. Restructured to chunk and save per chunk (rule 2).
No timing figure is published anywhere in this verdict (rule 26).
